title: Greensboro community remembers Northwest Guilford Middle School student athlete: 'Heart was second to none' - NewsBreak
text:
By Tiana Maxwell ,
48 minutes ago GUILFORD COUNTY, N.C. (WGHP) -- A crowd of people dressed in red mourned the loss of a Northwest Guilford Middle School student athlete at a community vigil on Wednesday night.
Community members stood side by side around the track at Northwest Guilford High School. Each person wore the color red, which was 13-year-old Caden Sorrell's favorite color.
Greensboro community honors Northwest Guilford Middle School student athlete (WGHP) A family friend told FOX8 that Caden died from complications after going into cardiac arrest on Friday during football practice.
Caden sported the number 42 on the field. He was a running back for the Northwest Guilford Middle School team.
Angie Hooker remembers her son playing on the team with Caden. She said the vigil shows the brotherhood of football.
"The football team was very close. They are like brothers, and I think it's great that they are here tonight to represent Caden and the family. It's just great for the community to come together as one tonight and remember Caden," Hooker said.
His family spoke to the crowd over the R.L. Billings Stadium speakers. His older sister remembered her brother as a kid who never knew a stranger, and a person who showed up for the people around him.
Alan Vaughn is a close family friend who remembers the teenager as a loving boy.
"His heart was second to none," Vaughn said. "He left every environment, every situation by hugging everyone in the room."
Caden's sister shared a heartbreaking sentiment.
"We were supposed to watch each other grow up and graduate," she said. "The hardest thing for me to comprehend is that you won't be at my wedding or meet my kids."
Vaughn said the family is pushing for schools to have more portable life-saving devices for sudden cardiac arrest called automated external defibrillators.
He said their push allowed for a device to be donated to the Northwest Guilford High School field house.
